newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones average rises more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones average rises more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average rose more than 50 points Tuesday, extending its recent run into record territory.

At 10:41 a.m. EDT, the index of 30 blue chip issues was up 56.81 points at 7,535.31, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading. But the Nasdaq composite index, laden with high-technology issues, fell 1.48 points to 1,410.56.
